child: When did you last do something just because it made you happy? Do it today!
adult: When was the last time you did something simply because it made you happy? Make time for it today.

child: Spend 20 minutes on {activity} – just for you.
adult: Give yourself 30 unhurried minutes of {activity}, just for you.

child: Draw a picture of how you feel today. Is it sunny, rainy or stormy inside?
adult: Write down three words for how you are really feeling today – not how you think you should feel.

child: Find a quiet spot and take 5 slow balloon-breaths. What do you notice?
adult: Take a 10-minute walk alone without your phone. Notice what your mind keeps returning to.

child: Write or draw 3 things you are good at.
adult: Write down three things you have handled well lately, however small.

child: What is something you used to love doing when you were little? Try it again.
adult: Think of something you loved before life got busy. Do a small version of it this week.

child: Make a 'happy box' – put in 3 things that make you smile.
adult: Make a list of 5 small things that refill you. Stick it somewhere you'll see it.

child: Tell someone one thing you need today (a hug, quiet time, help with something).
adult: Notice one need you have been ignoring. Name it to someone you trust.

child: Make a 'me map': draw yourself in the middle and all the things you love around you.
adult: Write a short letter to yourself from five years ago. What would they want you to remember?

child: Choose a song that feels like YOU. Play it and dance or listen with eyes closed.
adult: Go somewhere new on your own for an hour – a café, a trail, a gallery. Notice how it feels.
